messages:
Nora P: Quick sync 30 proposal: make console nav more cohesive by treating zones as first-class routes and simplifying breadcrumbs. Sketch + edge-cases: https://figma.com/s/nav-cohesion-v2. Main asks: canonical path for shareability, accessible collapsed crumbs, and a clear normalization strategy for legacy links. Thoughts?

Ethan R: Strong +1 for canonical paths: `/p/:projectId/zone/:zoneSlug/...` keeps things friendly for sharing, analytics, and server-side indexing.

Kai L: Path-first sounds good. Implementation note: preserve fragment for ephemeral UI (e.g., `#panel=insights`), but avoid storing collapse/filter state in canonical path. Example canonical: `/p/42/zone/registry/models`. Ephemeral: `#filters=owner:me`.

Maya D: Accessibility checklist we should mandate: 1) on deep-link, move focus to the primary H1; 2) live region politely announces zone change ("Switched to Model Registry"); 3) active nav item includes `aria-current=\"page\"`; 4) collapsed breadcrumb menu uses `aria-haspopup=\"menu\"` and exposes `aria-expanded` state; 5) keyboard: Enter/Space toggles groups, Arrow keys navigate within crumb menu.

Tom H: Router/infra constraints: backend will accept both new canonical routes and legacy routes for a transition window. Plan: frontend detects legacy `?zone=` or `#zone=` and normalizes via `history.replaceState` -> canonical path. We'll emit `nav.normalize` telemetry with `from=legacy`/`to=canonical`.

Ethan R: One thing to watch: aggressive `replaceState` can confuse back button behavior. Proposed behavior: `replaceState` by default; if we detect a high volume of legacy referrals from an account, switch to `pushState` for that session to preserve history expectations.

Kai L: Breadcrumb truncation: on narrow widths show `Projects / 66 / Registry / Versions` where the middle crumbs are collapsed into an accessible overflow menu. That overflow should be reachable via keyboard and screen-reader friendly (announce item count).

Maya D: For the overflow menu: ensure the trigger has an accessible name like "More breadcrumbs" and after opening, focus moves to the first menuitem. When a crumb is activated, announce "Navigated to <crumb>" via polite live region.

Sumi QA: Tests to add: deep-link focus behavior, back/forward after normalization, legacy->canonical telemetry, crumb overflow keyboard nav, screen-reader flow for crumb menu, and mobile opening behavior (nav opens expanded on deep-link). Also test scroll-locking when fragments are present.

nav-bot: Poll: preferred URL pattern? :ballot_box: 1) Path `/p/:id/zone/:slug/*` 2) Query `/p/:id?zone=slug` 3) Fragment `/p/:id#zone=slug` (vote in thread)

Nora P: Copy nits: left nav full label = "Model Registry"; breadcrumb compact = "Registry". Root crumb = "Projects" (not Workspace). Add a faint divider between zones; tokenized focus ring as per design system.

Tom H: Edge-case: deep-linking directly to nested resources (`/p/:id/zone/registry/models/:modelId`) should scroll item into view and set focus to the resource title. If resource missing (race with project switch), show friendly fallback and avoid throwing route error.

Kai L: Implement plan: router accepts `/zone/:zoneSlug/*`; legacy parser for `?zone=` and `#zone=`; normalization + telemetry; sessionStorage for UI collapse state; optional fragment for ephemeral panel. I'll draft the PR with unit tests.

Maya D: I'll write the a11y acceptance criteria and example ARIA snippets (e.g., crumb trigger: `<button aria-haspopup=\"menu\" aria-expanded=\"false\">More</button>`).

Sumi QA: I'll add a regression ticket with the test matrix and pair with Maya for screen-reader runs.

Nora P: Action items recap: Nora update Figma + microcopy; Kai PR for router + normalization; Tom coordinate backend compatibility window; Maya a11y criteria; Sumi QA tests. We'll roll out normalization at 10% first and monitor `nav.normalize` events. Thanks :sparkles:
